_comment: Curated by hand, not generated. The contribution figures on this page come from the GitHub search API, but quoting people is not something to automate: a sentiment filter would eventually lift a line out of context or quote criticism as praise. Every entry below is a real public comment, linked to its source so it can be checked. Quote verbatim; mark any elision with an ellipsis; remove an entry if the author asks.
